title: the blocks added to the generator's inputs under the movegen brief (Combat; tools/movegen)
description: Two new blocks, checked where they sit: parts.json `nameScreen` ($defs/nameScreen) and cells.json `pools` ($defs/pools). The rest of parts.json and cells.json is as the keys for Tools in docs/combat/pending/movegen/README.md section 5 describe; full schemas for those files are Tools' to write when they move to data/combat/. nameScreen: `allow`, phrases taken out of a name before it is screened against Legal's word lists, each with why. pools: `levels`, the key levels whose key set plays as it is; `rules`, a pool name of data/combat/recipes.json to a rule: `from` (a cell id), and optionally `form`, `filter`, `quota` (a quota name of that cell), `burst` (fast, mid or slow), `also` (an identity key listing move ids pinned in) and `neverAs` (a weight at which his never rows are read too). Cross-check (the generator's): every `from` is a cell of cells.json and every `quota` one of its quotas. Policy: closed, except keys starting with an underscore.
